welcomeTitle.description: Headline of the first-run onboarding page

welcomeSubtitle.message: Open any site and get the answer in one click — plus the evidence behind it, where the HTML was produced, and exactly which parts of the page JavaScript built.

welcomeStep1Body.message: Browsers hide new extensions behind the puzzle icon. Pin it so the report is always one click away.

welcomeStep2Body.message: The toolbar badge gives you the headline; the popup explains how it got there.

welcomeSsr.message: The content arrived in the initial HTML. Good for search engines and first paint.
welcomeSsr.description: Explanation of the SSR verdict on the onboarding page

welcomeCsr.message: The browser built the page from JavaScript. Typical of app-like single-page sites.
welcomeCsr.description: Explanation of the CSR verdict on the onboarding page

welcomeMix.message: Some of the page came from the server, the rest was hydrated or fetched afterwards.
welcomeMix.description: Explanation of the hybrid verdict on the onboarding page

welcomeStep3.message: Go deeper when you need to

welcomePrivacy.description: Privacy heading on the onboarding page

welcomePrivacyBody.message: Anonymous statistics — domain, render type, performance metrics, never full URLs or page content — help tune detection against the real web. Response headers and the region breakdown never leave your device. Opt out any time.
welcomePrivacyBody.description: Privacy body on the onboarding page

welcomeFeatureEvidenceBody.message: — every signal that moved the verdict, with the points it contributed.
welcomeFeatureEvidenceBody.description: Onboarding: what the Evidence tab shows; follows the bold 'Evidence' label

welcomeFeatureDeliveryBody.message: — whether the HTML was built at build time, served from a CDN cache, or rendered for this request, read straight from the response headers.
welcomeFeatureDeliveryBody.description: Onboarding: what the Delivery tab shows; follows the bold 'Delivery' label

welcomeFeatureRegionsBody.message: — which parts of the page the server sent and which ones JavaScript filled in.
welcomeFeatureRegionsBody.description: Onboarding: what the Regions tab shows; follows the bold 'Regions' label

welcomeFeaturePanelBody.message: — the same report, full width, re-running on every navigation. Look for “Rendering” in DevTools.
welcomeFeaturePanelBody.description: Onboarding: what the DevTools panel offers; follows the bold label

cacheLayers.description: Label for the per-tier cache states row in the Delivery tab

pageChanged.message: The page navigated while it was being analyzed. Run it again.
